ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Work Phone is entered in a correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( Work_Phone__c ) , NOT REGEX( Work_Phone__c , "^\\+?61[0-9]{9}+$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Work Phone Number in +61212345678 format.
